script.text: Declan sent Moon Shadow to protect Zuzu and Celina from Obelisk Force.
So who were those guys?
Warriors from the Fusion Dimension – sent here by Duel Academy.
Really!? The Fusion Dimension? That's why they're after us – I mean, after YOU, Lulu! How'd you escape? It must have been terrifying.
Do I look like a Lulu to you? My name is Celina!
Celina?
But you're right – those goons did come here to try and capture me. The Professor sent them after I refused to obey his orders.
I know there are fugitives from Xyz here and I'm determined to find and crush them!
The Professor will realize then how badly he blundered when he didn't send me to the front lines with the others!
So are these “front lines” in the Xyz Dimension?
That's right. I wanted to go and fight to make the universe a better place. In time, we will also assimilate the Synchro and Standard Dimensions until all are one!
It wasn't just duelists who were attacked by your people. Those invaders went after anyone and everyone!
You mean even people who weren't duelists?
I know a duelist from Xyz who's fighting to rescue his sister. She was taken prisoner by your people!
We wouldn't do that… would we? Are you sure about that?
His name is Shay Obsidian. Ask him about his sister and what happened in his home world.
Meanwhile, Dennis was meeting with Yuri, who hailed from the Fusion Dimension.
Oh hey… So how's it going, Yuri?
Did you find her?
Sure did! Zuzu has a lookalike. Her name's Celina. Ya know, kinda like how you and Yuya look similar.
Yuya? Who is he?
He's a duelist from the Standard Dimension.
Led by Sora, the Obelisk Force tracked down Celina.
What in the–?! Celina's surrounded.
Why are they here? I thought the Professor ordered only me to bring Zuzu back.
I made a promise to protect Celina. Let's duel!
